newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDISH REPO ALLOCATES 11.5 BLN SKR TO MARKET.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH REPO ALLOCATES 11.5 BLN SKR TO MARKET.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it allocated 11.5 billion crowns to the market in its weekly repurchase operation.
The one-week repo was set at an unchanged, fixed rate of 4.10 percent as expected by the market and will run from August 13 to August 20.
The operation replaces an operation that allocated 14.5 billion crowns to the market.
The Riksbank said 36.80 percent of the bids for the tender were allocated.
